title: Snoozer Quinn's playing
summary: Blanchin recalls Quinn later visiting the Grunewald music company and playing impressively.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: What did Snoozer play like then?

Well, truthfully, my interest wasn't great enough at that time to actually say that he was a great musician then. Of course, I know later that he did become a very great musician. But at that time, I wouldn't have been qualified to judge him anyway, I don't suppose.
Well, what did he play like when you do remember him?

Well, the next I heard of Snoozer was when I worked for the old Al Grunewald Music Company, and Snoozer came in occasionally to have his instrument repaired or maybe to get some strings and whatnot, and he'd sit back in a booth and play. And I thought he was a very wonderful musician.
Did he sound anything like the records that Johnny put on?
Yes, I would say so, yes.
